places.name: Moss Quay
places.public_description: The ferry noses alongside the quay; its deck is empty. Mara waves you aboard.

places.name: Floating Garden
places.public_description: Little green stars shine beneath the mulch. The empty tin rests by the planted bed.

commitments: Bring the tin to the floating garden.

recent_events: Mara smiles. “Would you take these seeds across? Ring the bell and the ferry will come.” She holds the tin out, waiting for your answer.
The tin is pleasantly warm in your hands. One bell-note sends ripples through the canal. A little rope-guided ferry bumps the quay.
You pull the guide rope, and the ferry slips through reflected stars. A sign beside the beds explains where the dry seeds belong.
Each seed sinks into the mulch with a soft chime. Green points of light appear along the bed. Mara is too far away to see this yet.

laws: The brass bell calls one ferry.
world.premise: A floating garden needs its dusk courier.
world.title: The Seed Ferry
